== DEVIATIONS FROM WI ==
- AnalyticsPage.tsx and AnalyticsPage.test.tsx are not in WI files_touched but must be updated to wire the tab
  (same deviation as WI-14a/14b which also updated those files)
- Dead WI-12 files deleted (4 files removed) — not in WI files_touched; done to close carried review findings
- ChartConfig dataset type doesn't include line-specific properties (fill, tension, pointRadius);
  used type assertion spread (`...({ fill: true, tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 3 } as Record<string, unknown>)`)
  to keep the pure builder type-safe without modifying the shared ChartConfig interface
- '#8b5cf6' (violet for Invoice/Dispatcher) is not in theme.ts. This is intentional: Chart.js charts need
  a third distinct color for the third payment type / source. The theme has no violet token. The value '#8b5cf6'
  is a well-known Tailwind violet-500 used consistently for the third category throughout the codebase
  (demand charts already use it as DOW_COLORS[5]). This is a documented non-theme constant.
